page.layout: One printed page with two columns, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: entries from "pl. fæm. Rad." to "sedere faciam te". Right column: entries from "Rad. יָשַׁב" to the end, including a centred section letter "א ז" in the lower part. No notes, no marginal text.

main_text.l: pl. fæm. Rad. אוֹר luce-re, vel אָרָה carpere.
אוֹרָה lux, אוֹרוֹת olera; No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. אוֹר lucere.
אוֹרָה docebo, אוֹרְךָ docebo te, &c. 1. f. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָרָה.
אוֹרִי lux mea, אוֹרְךָ lux tua, אוֹרְךָ, lux tua, אוֹרָם lux eorum, אוֹרֵהוּ lux ejus, &c. sing. masc. affix. Nom. אוֹר lux, Rad. אוֹר lucere.
אוֹרֵךְ urim tui, pl. m. affix. ex abs. אוֹרִים, Rad. אוֹר lucere.
אוֹרִישׁ expellam, &c. 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. יָרַשׁ.
אוֹרֵר maledicens, Ben. Kal, sing. m. Rad. אָרַר.
אוֹרִישׁ pauper fiam, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָרַשׁ.
אוֹשִׁינְךָ sedere faciam te, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix.
אוֹשִׁיעַ servabo, &c. 1. singul. futur. Hiph. Rad. יָשַׁע.
אוֹשַׁעַ servabor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָשַׁע.
אוֹתוֹתֵיו signa ejus, יָנוֹ signa nostra, &c. pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. אוֹת signum, vel Rad. אָתָה advenit.
אוֹתִיּוֹת eventura, Ben. Kal, pl. fæm. R. אָתָה.
אוֹת desiderium, בְּאוֹתִי in desiderio meo, &c. sing. fæm. constr. affix. No. אַוָּה desiderium, Rad. אָוָה concupiscere, Piel, אָוָה expetivit.
אוֹתָה expetit, præt. Piel, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. אָוָה.
אוֹתִיר relinquam, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. יָתַר.
אָזוֹר accinctus, אָזוֹר cin-gulum, &c. part. Paul, Kal, & No. sing. m, R.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking script is transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; the vowel points and some consonants are uncertain and may contain errors. Italic Latin glosses are rendered in plain text. The hyphenated "luce-re" and "cin-gulum" are line-end breaks with printed hyphens. The running head is taken from the Hebrew letters at the top of each column.
